cards.why: Demurrage on HLVU4410221 was last incurred on Wednesday 12 August 2026 and the invoice was issued on Monday 21 September, 40 days later. 46 CFR 541.7(a): an invoice issued more than 30 calendar days after the charge was last incurred need not be paid. The whole $1,000 is disputed

The invoice for HLVU4411875 leaves out the start and end dates of free time and the container availability date, which 46 CFR 541.6(b) requires on an import invoice; 541.5: failing to include any required item eliminates any obligation to pay. The whole $1,200 is disputed, inside 30 days of its 15 September date

Timely and complete, but it charges demurrage on Monday 7 (Labor Day, terminal closed), Tuesday 8 (Tropical Storm Hollis, closed) and Wednesday 9 September (not released for pickup), days HLVU4413050 could not be picked up. Halvard's own rule 21(c), consistent with 46 CFR 545.5, charges no demurrage for those days: 3 days at $200, $600 disputed; the other 4 days, $800, are owed

Detention on HLVU4412563 for 15 to 18 September, but Berthgate refused Halvard empties on 15, 16 and 17 September and Halvard named no other return location: detention when the empty cannot be returned is likely unreasonable (46 CFR 545.5(c)(2)(ii)) and Halvard's rule 21(c) does not charge it. 3 days at $150, $450 disputed; 18 September, $150, is owed

Trident's invoice for TRDU7721449 applies the tariff's 4 days of free time, but service contract TOS-2026-118 section 7.2 gives Brennick 10 days at Savannah and prevails over the tariff: free time ran 14 to 23 September, so demurrage is 24 and 25 September, 2 days at $225, $450. The invoice charges 8 days, $1,800: $1,350 is disputed

Detention on TRDU7719602 was last incurred on Friday 28 August 2026 and the invoice was issued on Thursday 1 October, 34 days later: under 46 CFR 541.7(a) Brennick is not required to pay it. The whole $875 is disputed

closing_words:
Two of Trident's four open invoices need a waiver request, for $2,225.00 in total. The other two are correct and left to pay. Nothing has been paid, and the two cards below are the requests.


**Disputed (2 of 4 open invoices)**

Free time runs 14 to 23 Sep, so only 24 and 25 Sep are chargeable. That is 2 days at $225, or $450. I'm disputing the 6 extra days.
- **TR-7748, $875.00 in full:** The detention last ran 28 Aug and the invoice is dated 1 Oct, which is 34 days later. The limit is 30 days (46 CFR 541.7(a)).

**Left alone, and why**
- **TR-7604, $1,125.00:** It is already waived in full under CN-7604, so there is nothing to dispute or pay.
- **TR-7710, $675.00:** The invoice applies the contract's 10 free days. Berth
